Package com.nexuslink.protocol.sqs

Class SqsService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.sqs.SqsService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SqsService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A thin AWS SQS client wrapper: list/create queues, send, receive (long-poll), delete and purge. Built on the AWS SDK v2 with the lightweight url-connection HTTP client (no Netty), mirroring the S3 module. Emulator-aware: pass a non-blank endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:4566) to target LocalStack or another S3/SQS-compatible endpoint; leave it blank for real AWS. Callers run these blocking calls off the UI thread.
